# Background 

Completed network analysis of the targeted metabolites and proteins to see the relationships between these metabolites and proteins between DCIS and IDC. The features utilized in this analysis were selected from a meta analysis (using FDR of 10%) and with direction from Nikki Cheng's team.  

In constructing the networks, I used Gaussian Graphical Models (GGMs) with a penalty term to get a sparse network (graphical lasso) using the R package glasso. Penalty/sparsity parameter set to rho=0.5,0.75,0.9 for metabolites and rho=0.1,0.25,0.4. The network based on only DIRECT relationships (as opposed to using correlation that uses both direct and indirect associations). Did not use CV to determine optimal penalty due to small sample size (N = 6 DCIS samples and N = 3 IDC samples). From the glasso results, the partial correlation was estimated and used for the qgraph function yielding the network plots. The estimated partial correlations can be found in the "DCIS_IDC_Network_Partial_Correlations_CS.xlsx" Excel spreadsheet. To fit Metabolite/Gene names, new annotations can be found in the  "DCIS_IDC_Network_Analysis_Annontations_CS.xlsx" Excel spreadsheet.

Batch 1 and Batch 2 networks for each analysis was compared using statistical functions from the igraph R package. It was used to compare the following aspects:  

- Number of Nodes (**num_nodes**): Total number of nodes in the graph. Indicates the size of the network.  
- Number of Edges (**num_edges**): Total number of edges in the graph. Shows how interconnected the nodes are.  
- Edge Density (**density**): Ratio of the number of edges to the number of possible edges. Measures how densely the graph is populated with edges. Higher density shows more of the total possible edges are present.  
- Clustering Coefficient (**clustering_coeff**): Measures likelihood (Global) that two neighbors of a node are also connected. Reflects the tendency of nodes to form tightly knit groups. Example: if node A is connected to B and C, then there's a high chance B and C are connected depending on this clustering likelihood coefficient.  
- Degree Centrality (**degree_centrality**): Counts the number of edges per node.  
- Betweenness Centrality (**betweenness_centrality**): Measures how often a node appears on the shortest paths between other nodes. Identifies nodes that act as bridges or bottlenecks in the network. Higher value means the node plays a critical role in connecting different parts of the network.  
- Closeness Centrality (**closeness_centrality**): Measures how close a node is to all other nodes. Indicates how quickly a node can access the rest of the network.  

The overall analysis for each network can be found in the "DCIS_IDC_Network_Batch_Comparison_CS.xlsx" Excel spreadsheet and individual Metabolite/Gene analysis comparing the 2 batches can be found in the "DCIS_IDC_Network_Stat_Comparison_CS.xlsx" Excel spreadsheet.  

**Targeted Totals**  
-9 samples (6 DCIS vs 3 IDC) on 35 metabolites in ICMS data  
-9 samples (6 DCIS vs 3 IDC) on 54 metabolites in HILIC data  
-9 samples (6 DCIS vs 3 IDC) on 3 protein in the Protein data  
-9 samples (6 DCIS vs 3 IDC) on 7 phosphoproteins in the phosphoprotein data

```{r readdata1, echo=FALSE}
# Function to compute key stats
network_mean_stats <- function(g) {
  list(
    num_nodes = vcount(g),
    num_edges = ecount(g),
    density = edge_density(g),
    # avg_path_length = if (is_connected(g)) mean_distance(g) else NA,
    clustering_coeff = transitivity(g, type = "global"),
    degree_centrality = mean(degree(g)),
    betweenness_centrality = mean(betweenness(g))
    # closeness_centrality = if (is_connected(g)) mean(closeness(g)) else NA
  )
}

# Convert precision matrix to partial correlations
partial.cor <- function(precision.mat) {
  D <- diag(1 / sqrt(diag(precision.mat)))
  -D %*% precision.mat %*% D
}

rho1 <- 0.5
rho2 <- 0.75
rho3 <- 0.9

remove(HILICdata,ICMSdata,PProteinData,ProteinData)

```

# DCIS vs IDC 

## Networks for each metabolite for ICMS for Batch 1 and Batch 2


```{r icmsnetwork, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11.5, fig.height=7}

#network analysis of icms data for both batches

icms.df.B1<- icms.data.B1 |> filter(Group != "Normal") |> select(-sampleID,-Group)
icms.df.B2<- icms.data.B2 |> filter(Group != "Normal") |> select(-sampleID,-Group)

ind.icms.B1.target<-colnames(icms.df.B1) %in% targets.icms$Metabolite.B1
ind.icms.B2.target<-colnames(icms.df.B2) %in% targets.icms$Metabolite.B2

icms.df.B1<-icms.df.B1[,ind.icms.B1.target]
icms.df.B2<-icms.df.B2[,ind.icms.B2.target]

n.icms <- dim(icms.df.B1)[2]

icms.new.ann.B1.temp <- data.frame(Metabolite.B1=colnames(icms.df.B1))
icms.new.ann.B2.temp <- data.frame(Metabolite.B2=colnames(icms.df.B2))

icms.new.ann.B1 <- inner_join(icms.new.ann.B1.temp,targets.icms,by = "Metabolite.B1") |> select(Metabolite.B1,HMDB)
icms.new.ann.B2 <- inner_join(icms.new.ann.B2.temp,targets.icms,by = "Metabolite.B2") |> select(Metabolite.B2,HMDB)

icms.new.ann.B1.sorted <- icms.new.ann.B1[order(icms.new.ann.B1$HMDB),]
icms.new.ann.B2.sorted <- icms.new.ann.B2[order(icms.new.ann.B2$HMDB),]

icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name <- paste0(rep("I",n.icms),1:n.icms)
icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name <- paste0(rep("I",n.icms),1:n.icms)

colnames(icms.df.B1) <- icms.new.ann.B1$HMDB
icms.df.B1.sorted <- icms.df.B1[,order(colnames(icms.df.B1))]
colnames(icms.df.B2) <- icms.new.ann.B2$HMDB
icms.df.B2.sorted <- icms.df.B2[,order(colnames(icms.df.B2))]

icms.df.B1.s<-var(icms.df.B1.sorted)
icms.df.B2.s<-var(icms.df.B2.sorted)

icms.df.B1.a.5<-glasso(icms.df.B1.s, rho=rho1)
icms.df.B2.a.5<-glasso(icms.df.B2.s, rho=rho1)
icms.df.B1.a.75<-glasso(icms.df.B1.s, rho=rho2)
icms.df.B2.a.75<-glasso(icms.df.B2.s, rho=rho2)
icms.df.B1.a.9<-glasso(icms.df.B1.s, rho=rho3)
icms.df.B2.a.9<-glasso(icms.df.B2.s, rho=rho3)


# Convert precision matrix to partial correlations
icms.partial.B1.5 <- partial.cor(icms.df.B1.a.5$wi)
icms.partial.B2.5 <- partial.cor(icms.df.B2.a.5$wi)
icms.partial.B1.75 <- partial.cor(icms.df.B1.a.75$wi)
icms.partial.B2.75 <- partial.cor(icms.df.B2.a.75$wi)
icms.partial.B1.9 <- partial.cor(icms.df.B1.a.9$wi)
icms.partial.B2.9 <- partial.cor(icms.df.B2.a.9$wi)

# Threshold partial correlations
thresh <- 1e-5  # Set your desired threshold
icms.partial.B1.5[abs(icms.partial.B1.5) < thresh] <- 0
icms.partial.B2.5[abs(icms.partial.B2.5) < thresh] <- 0
icms.partial.B1.75[abs(icms.partial.B1.75) < thresh] <- 0
icms.partial.B2.75[abs(icms.partial.B2.75) < thresh] <- 0
icms.partial.B1.9[abs(icms.partial.B1.9) < thresh] <- 0
icms.partial.B2.9[abs(icms.partial.B2.9) < thresh] <- 0

diag(icms.partial.B1.5) <- 0
diag(icms.partial.B2.5) <- 0
diag(icms.partial.B1.75) <- 0
diag(icms.partial.B2.75) <- 0
diag(icms.partial.B1.9) <- 0
diag(icms.partial.B2.9) <- 0


# Identify and remove nodes with no remaining edges
icms.partial.B1.5.connected <- apply(icms.partial.B1.5, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
icms.partial.B1.5.filtered <- icms.partial.B1.5[icms.partial.B1.5.connected, icms.partial.B1.5.connected]
icms.partial.B1.5.labels.filtered <- icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name[icms.partial.B1.5.connected]
icms.partial.B2.5.connected <- apply(icms.partial.B2.5, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
icms.partial.B2.5.filtered <- icms.partial.B2.5[icms.partial.B2.5.connected, icms.partial.B2.5.connected]
icms.partial.B2.5.labels.filtered <- icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name[icms.partial.B2.5.connected]

icms.partial.B1.75.connected <- apply(icms.partial.B1.75, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
icms.partial.B1.75.filtered <- icms.partial.B1.75[icms.partial.B1.75.connected, icms.partial.B1.75.connected]
icms.partial.B1.75.labels.filtered <- icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name[icms.partial.B1.75.connected]
icms.partial.B2.75.connected <- apply(icms.partial.B2.75, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
icms.partial.B2.75.filtered <- icms.partial.B2.75[icms.partial.B2.75.connected, icms.partial.B2.75.connected]
icms.partial.B2.75.labels.filtered <- icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name[icms.partial.B2.75.connected]

icms.partial.B1.9.connected <- apply(icms.partial.B1.9, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
icms.partial.B1.9.filtered <- icms.partial.B1.9[icms.partial.B1.9.connected, icms.partial.B1.9.connected]
icms.partial.B1.9.labels.filtered <- icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name[icms.partial.B1.9.connected]
icms.partial.B2.9.connected <- apply(icms.partial.B2.9, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
icms.partial.B2.9.filtered <- icms.partial.B2.9[icms.partial.B2.9.connected, icms.partial.B2.9.connected]
icms.partial.B2.9.labels.filtered <- icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name[icms.partial.B2.9.connected]


# rho=0.5
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.4))

qgraph(icms.partial.B1.5.filtered, labels = icms.partial.B1.5.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 8, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("ICMS data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho1),
       nodeNames = icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
qgraph(icms.partial.B2.5.filtered, labels = icms.partial.B2.5.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 8, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("ICMS data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho1),
       nodeNames = icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name,": ",icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB), cex = 0.8, bty = "n")

# rho=0.75
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.4))

qgraph(icms.partial.B1.75.filtered, labels = icms.partial.B1.75.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 8, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("ICMS data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho2),
       nodeNames = icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
qgraph(icms.partial.B2.75.filtered, labels = icms.partial.B2.75.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 8, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("ICMS data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho2),
       nodeNames = icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name,": ",icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB), cex = 0.8, bty = "n")

# rho=0.9
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.4))

qgraph(icms.partial.B1.9.filtered, labels = icms.partial.B1.9.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 8, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("ICMS data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho3),
       nodeNames = icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
qgraph(icms.partial.B2.9.filtered, labels = icms.partial.B2.9.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 8, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("ICMS data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho3),
       nodeNames = icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name,": ",icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB), cex = 0.8, bty = "n")

# Convert to adjacency matrices (non-zero off-diagonal entries indicate edges)
icms.adj.B1.5 <- (abs(icms.partial.B1.5) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(icms.adj.B1.5) <- 0
icms.adj.B2.5 <- (abs(icms.partial.B2.5) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(icms.adj.B2.5) <- 0
icms.adj.B1.75 <- (abs(icms.partial.B1.75) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(icms.adj.B1.75) <- 0
icms.adj.B2.75 <- (abs(icms.partial.B2.75) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(icms.adj.B2.75) <- 0
icms.adj.B1.9 <- (abs(icms.partial.B1.9) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(icms.adj.B1.9) <- 0
icms.adj.B2.9 <- (abs(icms.partial.B2.9) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(icms.adj.B2.9) <- 0

icms.g.B1.5 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(icms.adj.B1.5, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
icms.g.B2.5 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(icms.adj.B2.5, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
icms.g.B1.75 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(icms.adj.B1.75, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
icms.g.B2.75 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(icms.adj.B2.75, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
icms.g.B1.9 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(icms.adj.B1.9, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
icms.g.B2.9 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(icms.adj.B2.9, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

icms.stats.B1.5 <- network_mean_stats(icms.g.B1.5)
icms.stats.B2.5 <- network_mean_stats(icms.g.B2.5)
icms.stats.B1.75 <- network_mean_stats(icms.g.B1.75)
icms.stats.B2.75 <- network_mean_stats(icms.g.B2.75)
icms.stats.B1.9 <- network_mean_stats(icms.g.B1.9)
icms.stats.B2.9 <- network_mean_stats(icms.g.B2.9)

# Compare
icms.stats.comparison.5 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(icms.stats.B1.5),
  Batch1 = unlist(icms.stats.B1.5),
  Batch2 = unlist(icms.stats.B2.5)
)
icms.stats.comparison.75 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(icms.stats.B1.75),
  Batch1 = unlist(icms.stats.B1.75),

)
icms.stats.comparison.9 <- data.frame(

)


# Compare (Metabolite Level)
icms.network.stats.5.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B1=icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$Metabolite.B1,

                                   )
icms.network.stats.5.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B2=icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$Metabolite.B2,

                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.75=degree(icms.g.B1.75),

                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.75=closeness(icms.g.B2.75)
                                   )
icms.network.stats.9.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B1=icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$Metabolite.B1,
                                      HMDB=icms.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB,
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.9=degree(icms.g.B1.9),

                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.9=closeness(icms.g.B1.9)
                                   )
icms.network.stats.9.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B2=icms.new.ann.B2.sorted$Metabolite.B2,

icms.network.stats.5 <- inner_join(icms.network.stats.5.B1,icms.network.stats.5.B2,by = "HMDB") |>
  select(HMDB,Metabolite.B1,Metabolite.B2,degree.central.B1.rho.0.5,degree.central.B2.rho.0.5,

         betweenness.B1.rho.0.75,betweenness.B2.rho.0.75,closeness.B1.rho.0.75,closeness.B2.rho.0.75)

  select(HMDB,Metabolite.B1,Metabolite.B2,degree.central.B1.rho.0.9,degree.central.B2.rho.0.9,
         betweenness.B1.rho.0.9,betweenness.B2.rho.0.9,closeness.B1.rho.0.9,closeness.B2.rho.0.9)

icms.network.stats.5[is.na(icms.network.stats.5)] <- 0
icms.network.stats.75[is.na(icms.network.stats.75)] <- 0
icms.network.stats.9[is.na(icms.network.stats.9)] <- 0
```

## Networks for each metabolite for HILIC for Batch 1 and Batch 2



```{r hilicnetwork, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11.5, fig.height=7}

#network analysis of hilic data for both batches

hilic.df.B1<- hilic.data.B1 |> filter(Group != "Normal") |> select(-sampleID,-Group)
hilic.df.B2<- hilic.data.B2 |> filter(Group != "Normal") |> select(-sampleID,-Group)

ind.hilic.B1.target<-colnames(hilic.df.B1) %in% targets.hilic$Metabolite.B1
ind.hilic.B2.target<-colnames(hilic.df.B2) %in% targets.hilic$Metabolite.B2

hilic.df.B1<-hilic.df.B1[,ind.hilic.B1.target]
hilic.df.B2<-hilic.df.B2[,ind.hilic.B2.target]

n.hilic <- dim(hilic.df.B1)[2]

hilic.new.ann.B1.temp <- data.frame(Metabolite.B1=colnames(hilic.df.B1))
hilic.new.ann.B2.temp <- data.frame(Metabolite.B2=colnames(hilic.df.B2))

hilic.new.ann.B1 <- inner_join(hilic.new.ann.B1.temp,targets.hilic,by = "Metabolite.B1") |> select(Metabolite.B1,HMDB)
hilic.new.ann.B2 <- inner_join(hilic.new.ann.B2.temp,targets.hilic,by = "Metabolite.B2") |> select(Metabolite.B2,HMDB)

hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted <- hilic.new.ann.B1[order(hilic.new.ann.B1$HMDB),]
hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted <- hilic.new.ann.B2[order(hilic.new.ann.B2$HMDB),]

hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name <- paste0(rep("H",n.hilic),1:n.hilic)
hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name <- paste0(rep("H",n.hilic),1:n.hilic)

colnames(hilic.df.B1) <- hilic.new.ann.B1$HMDB
hilic.df.B1.sorted <- hilic.df.B1[,order(colnames(hilic.df.B1))]
colnames(hilic.df.B2) <- hilic.new.ann.B2$HMDB
hilic.df.B2.sorted <- hilic.df.B2[,order(colnames(hilic.df.B2))]

hilic.df.B1.s<-var(hilic.df.B1.sorted)
hilic.df.B2.s<-var(hilic.df.B2.sorted)

hilic.df.B1.a.5<-glasso(hilic.df.B1.s, rho=rho1)
hilic.df.B2.a.5<-glasso(hilic.df.B2.s, rho=rho1)
hilic.df.B1.a.75<-glasso(hilic.df.B1.s, rho=rho2)
hilic.df.B2.a.75<-glasso(hilic.df.B2.s, rho=rho2)
hilic.df.B1.a.9<-glasso(hilic.df.B1.s, rho=rho3)
hilic.df.B2.a.9<-glasso(hilic.df.B2.s, rho=rho3)

# Convert precision matrix to partial correlations
hilic.partial.B1.5 <- partial.cor(hilic.df.B1.a.5$wi)
hilic.partial.B2.5 <- partial.cor(hilic.df.B2.a.5$wi)
hilic.partial.B1.75 <- partial.cor(hilic.df.B1.a.75$wi)
hilic.partial.B2.75 <- partial.cor(hilic.df.B2.a.75$wi)
hilic.partial.B1.9 <- partial.cor(hilic.df.B1.a.9$wi)
hilic.partial.B2.9 <- partial.cor(hilic.df.B2.a.9$wi)

# Threshold partial correlations
thresh <- 1e-5  # Set your desired threshold
hilic.partial.B1.5[abs(hilic.partial.B1.5) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.partial.B2.5[abs(hilic.partial.B2.5) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.partial.B1.75[abs(hilic.partial.B1.75) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.partial.B2.75[abs(hilic.partial.B2.75) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.partial.B1.9[abs(hilic.partial.B1.9) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.partial.B2.9[abs(hilic.partial.B2.9) < thresh] <- 0

diag(hilic.partial.B1.5) <- 0
diag(hilic.partial.B2.5) <- 0
diag(hilic.partial.B1.75) <- 0
diag(hilic.partial.B2.75) <- 0
diag(hilic.partial.B1.9) <- 0
diag(hilic.partial.B2.9) <- 0


# Identify and remove nodes with no remaining edges
hilic.partial.B1.5.connected <- apply(hilic.partial.B1.5, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.partial.B1.5.filtered <- hilic.partial.B1.5[hilic.partial.B1.5.connected, hilic.partial.B1.5.connected]
hilic.partial.B1.5.labels.filtered <- hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name[hilic.partial.B1.5.connected]
hilic.partial.B2.5.connected <- apply(hilic.partial.B2.5, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.partial.B2.5.filtered <- hilic.partial.B2.5[hilic.partial.B2.5.connected, hilic.partial.B2.5.connected]
hilic.partial.B2.5.labels.filtered <- hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name[hilic.partial.B2.5.connected]

hilic.partial.B1.75.connected <- apply(hilic.partial.B1.75, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.partial.B1.75.filtered <- hilic.partial.B1.75[hilic.partial.B1.75.connected, hilic.partial.B1.75.connected]
hilic.partial.B1.75.labels.filtered <- hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name[hilic.partial.B1.75.connected]
hilic.partial.B2.75.connected <- apply(hilic.partial.B2.75, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.partial.B2.75.filtered <- hilic.partial.B2.75[hilic.partial.B2.75.connected, hilic.partial.B2.75.connected]
hilic.partial.B2.75.labels.filtered <- hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name[hilic.partial.B2.75.connected]

hilic.partial.B1.9.connected <- apply(hilic.partial.B1.9, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.partial.B1.9.filtered <- hilic.partial.B1.9[hilic.partial.B1.9.connected, hilic.partial.B1.9.connected]
hilic.partial.B1.9.labels.filtered <- hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$New.Name[hilic.partial.B1.9.connected]
hilic.partial.B2.9.connected <- apply(hilic.partial.B2.9, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.partial.B2.9.filtered <- hilic.partial.B2.9[hilic.partial.B2.9.connected, hilic.partial.B2.9.connected]
hilic.partial.B2.9.labels.filtered <- hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name[hilic.partial.B2.9.connected]

# rho=0.5
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.4))

qgraph(hilic.partial.B1.5.filtered, labels = hilic.partial.B1.5.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho1),
       nodeNames = hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
qgraph(hilic.partial.B2.5.filtered, labels = hilic.partial.B2.5.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho1),
       nodeNames = hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name,": ",hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB), cex = 0.8, bty = "n")

# rho=0.75
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.4))

qgraph(hilic.partial.B1.75.filtered, labels = hilic.partial.B1.75.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho2),
       nodeNames = hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
qgraph(hilic.partial.B2.75.filtered, labels = hilic.partial.B2.75.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIc data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho2),
       nodeNames = hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name,": ",hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB), cex = 0.8, bty = "n")

# rho=0.9
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.4))

qgraph(hilic.partial.B1.9.filtered, labels = hilic.partial.B1.9.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho3),
       nodeNames = hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
qgraph(hilic.partial.B2.9.filtered, labels = hilic.partial.B2.9.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.3, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho3),
       nodeNames = hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$New.Name,": ",hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB), cex = 0.8, bty = "n")


# hilic.prec.B1.5 <- hilic.df.B1.a.5$wi
# hilic.prec.B2.5 <- hilic.df.B2.a.5$wi
# hilic.prec.B1.75 <- hilic.df.B1.a.75$wi
# hilic.prec.B2.75 <- hilic.df.B2.a.75$wi
# hilic.prec.B1.9 <- hilic.df.B1.a.9$wi
# hilic.prec.B2.9 <- hilic.df.B2.a.9$wi

# Convert to adjacency matrices (non-zero off-diagonal entries indicate edges)
hilic.adj.B1.5 <- (abs(hilic.partial.B1.5) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(hilic.adj.B1.5) <- 0
hilic.adj.B2.5 <- (abs(hilic.partial.B2.5) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(hilic.adj.B2.5) <- 0
hilic.adj.B1.75 <- (abs(hilic.partial.B1.75) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(hilic.adj.B1.75) <- 0
hilic.adj.B2.75 <- (abs(hilic.partial.B2.75) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(hilic.adj.B2.75) <- 0
hilic.adj.B1.9 <- (abs(hilic.partial.B1.9) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(hilic.adj.B1.9) <- 0
hilic.adj.B2.9 <- (abs(hilic.partial.B2.9) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(hilic.adj.B2.9) <- 0

hilic.g.B1.5 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(hilic.adj.B1.5, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
hilic.g.B2.5 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(hilic.adj.B2.5, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
hilic.g.B1.75 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(hilic.adj.B1.75, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
hilic.g.B2.75 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(hilic.adj.B2.75, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
hilic.g.B1.9 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(hilic.adj.B1.9, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
hilic.g.B2.9 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(hilic.adj.B2.9, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

hilic.stats.B1.5 <- network_mean_stats(hilic.g.B1.5)
hilic.stats.B2.5 <- network_mean_stats(hilic.g.B2.5)
hilic.stats.B1.75 <- network_mean_stats(hilic.g.B1.75)
hilic.stats.B2.75 <- network_mean_stats(hilic.g.B2.75)
hilic.stats.B1.9 <- network_mean_stats(hilic.g.B1.9)
hilic.stats.B2.9 <- network_mean_stats(hilic.g.B2.9)

# Compare
hilic.stats.comparison.5 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(hilic.stats.B1.5),
  Batch1 = unlist(hilic.stats.B1.5),
  Batch2 = unlist(hilic.stats.B2.5)
)
hilic.stats.comparison.75 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(hilic.stats.B1.75),
  Batch1 = unlist(hilic.stats.B1.75),

)

  Metric = names(hilic.stats.B1.9),
  Batch1 = unlist(hilic.stats.B1.9),
  Batch2 = unlist(hilic.stats.B2.9)
)


# Compare (Metabolite Level)
hilic.network.stats.5.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B1=hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$Metabolite.B1,
                                      HMDB=hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB,
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.5=degree(hilic.g.B1.5),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.5=betweenness(hilic.g.B1.5),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.5=closeness(hilic.g.B1.5)
                                   )
hilic.network.stats.5.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B2=hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$Metabolite.B2,
                                      HMDB=hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB,
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.5=degree(hilic.g.B2.5),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.5=betweenness(hilic.g.B2.5),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.5=closeness(hilic.g.B2.5)
                                   )
hilic.network.stats.75.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B1=hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$Metabolite.B1,
                                       HMDB=hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB,
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.75=degree(hilic.g.B1.75),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.75=betweenness(hilic.g.B1.75),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.75=closeness(hilic.g.B1.75)
                                   )
hilic.network.stats.75.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B2=hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$Metabolite.B2,
                                       HMDB=hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$HMDB,
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.75=degree(hilic.g.B2.75),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.75=betweenness(hilic.g.B2.75),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.75=closeness(hilic.g.B2.75)
                                   )
hilic.network.stats.9.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B1=hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$Metabolite.B1,
                                      HMDB=hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted$HMDB,
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.9=degree(hilic.g.B1.9),

                                   )
hilic.network.stats.9.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite.B2=hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted$Metabolite.B2,

                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.9=degree(hilic.g.B2.9),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.9=betweenness(hilic.g.B2.9),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.9=closeness(hilic.g.B2.9)
                                   )

hilic.network.stats.5 <- inner_join(hilic.network.stats.5.B1,hilic.network.stats.5.B2,by = "HMDB") |>
  select(HMDB,Metabolite.B1,Metabolite.B2,degree.central.B1.rho.0.5,degree.central.B2.rho.0.5,
         betweenness.B1.rho.0.5,betweenness.B2.rho.0.5,closeness.B1.rho.0.5,closeness.B2.rho.0.5)
hilic.network.stats.75 <- inner_join(hilic.network.stats.75.B1,hilic.network.stats.75.B2,by = "HMDB") |>
  select(HMDB,Metabolite.B1,Metabolite.B2,degree.central.B1.rho.0.75,degree.central.B2.rho.0.75,
         betweenness.B1.rho.0.75,betweenness.B2.rho.0.75,closeness.B1.rho.0.75,closeness.B2.rho.0.75)
hilic.network.stats.9 <- inner_join(hilic.network.stats.9.B1,hilic.network.stats.9.B2,by = "HMDB") |>
  select(HMDB,Metabolite.B1,Metabolite.B2,degree.central.B1.rho.0.9,degree.central.B2.rho.0.9,
         betweenness.B1.rho.0.9,betweenness.B2.rho.0.9,closeness.B1.rho.0.9,closeness.B2.rho.0.9)

hilic.network.stats.75[is.na(hilic.network.stats.75)] <- 0
```

## Networks for each protein for Proteomic Data for Batch 1 and Batch 2



```{r proteinnetwork, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

rho1p <- 0.1
rho2p <- 0.25
rho3p <- 0.4

#network analysis of icms data for both batches

protein.df.B1<- protein.data.B1 |> filter(group != "Normal" & group != "Normal.Adj") |> select(-sampleID,-group,-Pair)
protein.df.B2<- protein.data.B2 |> select(-sampleID,-group)

ind.protein.B1.target<-colnames(protein.df.B1) %in% targets.proteins$Gene
ind.protein.B2.target<-colnames(protein.df.B2) %in% targets.proteins$Gene

protein.df.B1<-protein.df.B1[,ind.protein.B1.target]
protein.df.B2<-protein.df.B2[,ind.protein.B2.target]

protein.new.ann.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite=colnames(protein.df.B1),New.Name=paste0(rep("P",dim(protein.df.B1)[2]),1:dim(protein.df.B1)[2]))
protein.new.ann.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite=colnames(protein.df.B2),New.Name=paste0(rep("P",dim(protein.df.B2)[2]),1:dim(protein.df.B2)[2]))

protein.df.B1.s<-var(protein.df.B1)
protein.df.B2.s<-var(protein.df.B2)

protein.df.B1.a.1<-glasso(protein.df.B1.s, rho=rho1p)
protein.df.B2.a.1<-glasso(protein.df.B2.s, rho=rho1p)
protein.df.B1.a.25<-glasso(protein.df.B1.s, rho=rho2p)
protein.df.B2.a.25<-glasso(protein.df.B2.s, rho=rho2p)
protein.df.B1.a.4<-glasso(protein.df.B1.s, rho=rho3p)
protein.df.B2.a.4<-glasso(protein.df.B2.s, rho=rho3p)

# Convert precision matrix to partial correlations
protein.partial.B1.1 <- partial.cor(protein.df.B1.a.1$wi)
protein.partial.B2.1 <- partial.cor(protein.df.B2.a.1$wi)
protein.partial.B1.25 <- partial.cor(protein.df.B1.a.25$wi)
protein.partial.B2.25 <- partial.cor(protein.df.B2.a.25$wi)
protein.partial.B1.4 <- partial.cor(protein.df.B1.a.4$wi)
protein.partial.B2.4 <- partial.cor(protein.df.B2.a.4$wi)

# Threshold partial correlations
thresh <- 1e-5  # Set your desired threshold
protein.partial.B1.1[abs(protein.partial.B1.1) < thresh] <- 0
protein.partial.B2.1[abs(protein.partial.B2.1) < thresh] <- 0
protein.partial.B1.25[abs(protein.partial.B1.25) < thresh] <- 0
protein.partial.B2.25[abs(protein.partial.B2.25) < thresh] <- 0
protein.partial.B1.4[abs(protein.partial.B1.4) < thresh] <- 0
protein.partial.B2.4[abs(protein.partial.B2.4) < thresh] <- 0

diag(protein.partial.B1.1) <- 0
diag(protein.partial.B2.1) <- 0
diag(protein.partial.B1.25) <- 0
diag(protein.partial.B2.25) <- 0
diag(protein.partial.B1.4) <- 0
diag(protein.partial.B2.4) <- 0


# Identify and remove nodes with no remaining edges
protein.partial.B1.1.connected <- apply(protein.partial.B1.1, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.partial.B1.1.filtered <- protein.partial.B1.1[protein.partial.B1.1.connected, protein.partial.B1.1.connected]
protein.partial.B1.1.labels.filtered <- protein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[protein.partial.B1.1.connected]
protein.partial.B2.1.connected <- apply(protein.partial.B2.1, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.partial.B2.1.filtered <- protein.partial.B2.1[protein.partial.B2.1.connected, protein.partial.B2.1.connected]
protein.partial.B2.1.labels.filtered <- protein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[protein.partial.B2.1.connected]

protein.partial.B1.25.connected <- apply(protein.partial.B1.25, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.partial.B1.25.filtered <- protein.partial.B1.25[protein.partial.B1.25.connected, protein.partial.B1.25.connected]
protein.partial.B1.25.labels.filtered <- protein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[protein.partial.B1.25.connected]
protein.partial.B2.25.connected <- apply(protein.partial.B2.25, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.partial.B2.25.filtered <- protein.partial.B2.25[protein.partial.B2.25.connected, protein.partial.B2.25.connected]
protein.partial.B2.25.labels.filtered <- protein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[protein.partial.B2.25.connected]

protein.partial.B1.4.connected <- apply(protein.partial.B1.4, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.partial.B1.4.filtered <- protein.partial.B1.4[protein.partial.B1.4.connected, protein.partial.B1.4.connected]
protein.partial.B1.4.labels.filtered <- protein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[protein.partial.B1.4.connected]
protein.partial.B2.4.connected <- apply(protein.partial.B2.4, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.partial.B2.4.filtered <- protein.partial.B2.4[protein.partial.B2.4.connected, protein.partial.B2.4.connected]
protein.partial.B2.4.labels.filtered <- protein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[protein.partial.B2.4.connected]


# rho=0.1
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.5))

qgraph(protein.partial.B1.1.filtered, labels = protein.partial.B1.1.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("Proteomic data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho1p),
       nodeNames = protein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(protein.partial.B2.1.filtered, labels = protein.partial.B2.1.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("Proteomic data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho1p),
       nodeNames = protein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(protein.new.ann.B1$New.Name,": ", protein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

# rho=0.25
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.5))

qgraph(protein.partial.B1.25.filtered, labels = protein.partial.B1.25.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("Proteomic data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho2p),
       nodeNames = protein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(protein.partial.B2.25.filtered, labels = protein.partial.B2.25.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("Proteomic data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho2p),
       nodeNames = protein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(protein.new.ann.B1$New.Name,": ", protein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

# rho=0.4
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.5))

qgraph(protein.partial.B1.4.filtered, labels = protein.partial.B1.4.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("Proteomic data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho3p),
       nodeNames = protein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(protein.partial.B2.4.filtered, labels = protein.partial.B2.4.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("Proteomic data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho3p),
       nodeNames = protein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(protein.new.ann.B1$New.Name,": ", protein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

# protein.prec.B1.1 <- protein.df.B1.a.1$wi
# protein.prec.B2.1 <- protein.df.B2.a.1$wi
# protein.prec.B1.25 <- protein.df.B1.a.25$wi
# protein.prec.B2.25 <- protein.df.B2.a.25$wi
# protein.prec.B1.4 <- protein.df.B1.a.4$wi
# protein.prec.B2.4 <- protein.df.B2.a.4$wi

# Convert to adjacency matrices (non-zero off-diagonal entries indicate edges)
protein.adj.B1.1 <- (abs(protein.partial.B1.1) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.adj.B1.1) <- 0
protein.adj.B2.1 <- (abs(protein.partial.B2.1) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.adj.B2.1) <- 0
protein.adj.B1.25 <- (abs(protein.partial.B1.25) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.adj.B1.25) <- 0
protein.adj.B2.25 <- (abs(protein.partial.B2.25) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.adj.B2.25) <- 0
protein.adj.B1.4 <- (abs(protein.partial.B1.4) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.adj.B1.4) <- 0
protein.adj.B2.4 <- (abs(protein.partial.B2.4) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.adj.B2.4) <- 0

protein.g.B1.1 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.adj.B1.1, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.g.B2.1 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.adj.B2.1, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.g.B1.25 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.adj.B1.25, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.g.B2.25 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.adj.B2.25, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.g.B1.4 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.adj.B1.4, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.g.B2.4 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.adj.B2.4, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

protein.stats.B1.1 <- network_mean_stats(protein.g.B1.1)
protein.stats.B2.1 <- network_mean_stats(protein.g.B2.1)
protein.stats.B1.25 <- network_mean_stats(protein.g.B1.25)
protein.stats.B2.25 <- network_mean_stats(protein.g.B2.25)
protein.stats.B1.4 <- network_mean_stats(protein.g.B1.4)
protein.stats.B2.4 <- network_mean_stats(protein.g.B2.4)

# Compare
protein.stats.comparison.1 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(protein.stats.B1.1),
  Batch1 = unlist(protein.stats.B1.1),
  Batch2 = unlist(protein.stats.B2.1)
)
protein.stats.comparison.25 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(protein.stats.B1.25),
  Batch1 = unlist(protein.stats.B1.25),
  Batch2 = unlist(protein.stats.B2.25)
)
protein.stats.comparison.4 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(protein.stats.B1.4),
  Batch1 = unlist(protein.stats.B1.4),
  Batch2 = unlist(protein.stats.B2.4)
)


# Compare (Protein Level)
protein.network.stats.1.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(protein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.1=degree(protein.g.B1.1),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.1=betweenness(protein.g.B1.1),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.1=closeness(protein.g.B1.1)
                                   )
protein.network.stats.1.B2 <- data.frame(Gene.B2=colnames(protein.df.B2),
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.1=degree(protein.g.B2.1),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.1=betweenness(protein.g.B2.1),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.1=closeness(protein.g.B2.1)
                                   )
protein.network.stats.25.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(protein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.25=degree(protein.g.B1.25),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.25=betweenness(protein.g.B1.25),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.25=closeness(protein.g.B1.25)
                                   )
protein.network.stats.25.B2 <- data.frame(Gene.B2=colnames(protein.df.B2),
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.25=degree(protein.g.B2.25),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.25=betweenness(protein.g.B2.25),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.25=closeness(protein.g.B2.25)
                                   )
protein.network.stats.4.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(protein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.4=degree(protein.g.B1.4),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.4=betweenness(protein.g.B1.4),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.4=closeness(protein.g.B1.4)
                                   )
protein.network.stats.4.B2 <- data.frame(Gene.B2=colnames(protein.df.B2),
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.4=degree(protein.g.B2.4),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.4=betweenness(protein.g.B2.4),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.4=closeness(protein.g.B2.4)
                                   )


protein.network.stats.1 <- inner_join(protein.network.stats.1.B1,protein.network.stats.1.B2,by=c("Gene.B1" = "Gene.B2")) |>
  select(Gene=Gene.B1,degree.central.B1.rho.0.1,degree.central.B2.rho.0.1,betweenness.B1.rho.0.1,betweenness.B2.rho.0.1,
         closeness.B1.rho.0.1,closeness.B2.rho.0.1)
protein.network.stats.25 <- inner_join(protein.network.stats.25.B1,protein.network.stats.25.B2,by=c("Gene.B1" = "Gene.B2")) |>
  select(Gene=Gene.B1,degree.central.B1.rho.0.25,degree.central.B2.rho.0.25,betweenness.B1.rho.0.25,betweenness.B2.rho.0.25,
         closeness.B1.rho.0.25,closeness.B2.rho.0.25)
protein.network.stats.4 <- inner_join(protein.network.stats.4.B1,protein.network.stats.4.B2,by=c("Gene.B1" = "Gene.B2")) |>
  select(Gene=Gene.B1,degree.central.B1.rho.0.4,degree.central.B2.rho.0.4,betweenness.B1.rho.0.4,betweenness.B2.rho.0.4,
         closeness.B1.rho.0.4,closeness.B2.rho.0.4)

protein.network.stats.1[is.na(protein.network.stats.1)] <- 0
protein.network.stats.25[is.na(protein.network.stats.25)] <- 0
protein.network.stats.4[is.na(protein.network.stats.4)] <- 0
```

## Networks for each protein for Phosphoproteomic Data for Batch 1 and Batch 2

```{r pproteinnetwork, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

#network analysis of phosphoprotein together


n.pprotein.B1<-dim(annonation.pprotein.B1)[1]
new.ann.B1 <- paste0(annonation.pprotein.B1$`Master Protein Accessions`,".",annonation.pprotein.B1$`Gene Symbol`,".",
                  annonation.pprotein.B1$`Annotated Sequence`,".",annonation.pprotein.B1$Modifications)
for(j in 1:dim(annonation.pprotein.B1)[1]){
  if(is.na(annonation.pprotein.B1$Modifications[j])){
    new.ann.B1[j] <- substr(new.ann.B1[j], 1, nchar(new.ann.B1[j]) - 3)
  }
}
colnames(pprotein.data.B1)[2:(n.pprotein.B1+1)] <- new.ann.B1

n.pprotein.B2<-dim(annonation.pprotein.B2)[1]
new.ann.B2 <- paste0(annonation.pprotein.B2$`Master Protein Accessions`,".",annonation.pprotein.B2$`Gene Symbol`,".",
                     annonation.pprotein.B2$`Annotated Sequence`,".",annonation.pprotein.B2$Modifications)
for(j in 1:dim(annonation.pprotein.B2)[1]){
  if(is.na(annonation.pprotein.B2$Modifications[j])){
    new.ann.B2[j] <- substr(new.ann.B2[j], 1, nchar(new.ann.B2[j]) - 3)
  }
}
colnames(pprotein.data.B2)[1:n.pprotein.B2] <- new.ann.B2

pprotein.df.B1<- pprotein.data.B1 |> filter(group != "Normal" & group != "Normal.Adj") |> select(-sampleID,-group,-Pair)
pprotein.df.B2<- pprotein.data.B2 |> select(-sampleID,-group)

ind.pprotein.B1.target<-colnames(pprotein.df.B1) %in% targets.pproteins$Gene
ind.pprotein.B2.target<-colnames(pprotein.df.B2) %in% targets.pproteins$Gene

pprotein.df.B1<-pprotein.df.B1[,ind.pprotein.B1.target]
pprotein.df.B2<-pprotein.df.B2[,ind.pprotein.B2.target]

pprotein.new.ann.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite=colnames(pprotein.df.B1),New.Name=paste0(rep("PP",dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2]),1:dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2]))
pprotein.new.ann.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite=colnames(pprotein.df.B2),New.Name=paste0(rep("PP",dim(pprotein.df.B2)[2]),1:dim(pprotein.df.B2)[2]))

pprotein.df.B1.s<-var(pprotein.df.B1)
pprotein.df.B2.s<-var(pprotein.df.B2)

pprotein.df.B1.a.1<-glasso(pprotein.df.B1.s, rho=rho1p)
pprotein.df.B2.a.1<-glasso(pprotein.df.B2.s, rho=rho1p)
pprotein.df.B1.a.25<-glasso(pprotein.df.B1.s, rho=rho2p)
pprotein.df.B2.a.25<-glasso(pprotein.df.B2.s, rho=rho2p)
pprotein.df.B1.a.4<-glasso(pprotein.df.B1.s, rho=rho3p)
pprotein.df.B2.a.4<-glasso(pprotein.df.B2.s, rho=rho3p)

# Convert precision matrix to partial correlations
pprotein.partial.B1.1 <- partial.cor(pprotein.df.B1.a.1$wi)
pprotein.partial.B2.1 <- partial.cor(pprotein.df.B2.a.1$wi)
pprotein.partial.B1.25 <- partial.cor(pprotein.df.B1.a.25$wi)
pprotein.partial.B2.25 <- partial.cor(pprotein.df.B2.a.25$wi)
pprotein.partial.B1.4 <- partial.cor(pprotein.df.B1.a.4$wi)
pprotein.partial.B2.4 <- partial.cor(pprotein.df.B2.a.4$wi)

# Threshold partial correlations
thresh <- 1e-5  # Set your desired threshold
pprotein.partial.B1.1[abs(pprotein.partial.B1.1) < thresh] <- 0
pprotein.partial.B2.1[abs(pprotein.partial.B2.1) < thresh] <- 0
pprotein.partial.B1.25[abs(pprotein.partial.B1.25) < thresh] <- 0
pprotein.partial.B2.25[abs(pprotein.partial.B2.25) < thresh] <- 0
pprotein.partial.B1.4[abs(pprotein.partial.B1.4) < thresh] <- 0
pprotein.partial.B2.4[abs(pprotein.partial.B2.4) < thresh] <- 0

diag(pprotein.partial.B1.1) <- 0
diag(pprotein.partial.B2.1) <- 0
diag(pprotein.partial.B1.25) <- 0
diag(pprotein.partial.B2.25) <- 0
diag(pprotein.partial.B1.4) <- 0
diag(pprotein.partial.B2.4) <- 0


# Identify and remove nodes with no remaining edges
pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected <- apply(pprotein.partial.B1.1, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
pprotein.partial.B1.1.filtered <- pprotein.partial.B1.1[pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected, pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected]
pprotein.partial.B1.1.labels.filtered <- pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected]
pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected <- apply(pprotein.partial.B2.1, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
pprotein.partial.B2.1.filtered <- pprotein.partial.B2.1[pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected, pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected]
pprotein.partial.B2.1.labels.filtered <- pprotein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected]

pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected <- apply(pprotein.partial.B1.25, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
pprotein.partial.B1.25.filtered <- pprotein.partial.B1.25[pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected, pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected]
pprotein.partial.B1.25.labels.filtered <- pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected]
pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected <- apply(pprotein.partial.B2.25, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
pprotein.partial.B2.25.filtered <- pprotein.partial.B2.25[pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected, pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected]
pprotein.partial.B2.25.labels.filtered <- pprotein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected]

pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected <- apply(pprotein.partial.B1.4, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
pprotein.partial.B1.4.filtered <- pprotein.partial.B1.4[pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected, pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected]
pprotein.partial.B1.4.labels.filtered <- pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected]
pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected <- apply(pprotein.partial.B2.4, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
pprotein.partial.B2.4.filtered <- pprotein.partial.B2.4[pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected, pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected]
pprotein.partial.B2.4.labels.filtered <- pprotein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected]

# rho=0.1
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.5))

qgraph(pprotein.partial.B1.1.filtered, labels = pprotein.partial.B1.1.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProteomic data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho1p),
       nodeNames = pprotein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(pprotein.partial.B2.1.filtered, labels = pprotein.partial.B2.1.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProteomic data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho1p),
       nodeNames = pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name,": ", pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

# rho=0.25
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.5))

qgraph(pprotein.partial.B1.25.filtered, labels = pprotein.partial.B1.25.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProteomic data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho2p),
       nodeNames = pprotein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(pprotein.partial.B2.25.filtered, labels = pprotein.partial.B2.25.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProteomic data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho2p),
       nodeNames = pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name,": ", pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

# rho=0.4
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.5))

qgraph(pprotein.partial.B1.4.filtered, labels = pprotein.partial.B1.4.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProteomic data (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho3p),
       nodeNames = pprotein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(pprotein.partial.B2.4.filtered, labels = pprotein.partial.B2.4.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE, diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.25, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProteomic data (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho3p),
       nodeNames = pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name,": ", pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")


# pprotein.prec.B1.1 <- pprotein.df.B1.a.1$wi
# pprotein.prec.B2.1 <- pprotein.df.B2.a.1$wi
# pprotein.prec.B1.25 <- pprotein.df.B1.a.25$wi
# pprotein.prec.B2.25 <- pprotein.df.B2.a.25$wi
# pprotein.prec.B1.4 <- pprotein.df.B1.a.4$wi
# pprotein.prec.B2.4 <- pprotein.df.B2.a.4$wi

# Convert to adjacency matrices (non-zero off-diagonal entries indicate edges)
pprotein.adj.B1.1 <- (abs(pprotein.partial.B1.1) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(pprotein.adj.B1.1) <- 0
pprotein.adj.B2.1 <- (abs(pprotein.partial.B2.1) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(pprotein.adj.B2.1) <- 0
pprotein.adj.B1.25 <- (abs(pprotein.partial.B1.25) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(pprotein.adj.B1.25) <- 0
pprotein.adj.B2.25 <- (abs(pprotein.partial.B2.25) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(pprotein.adj.B2.25) <- 0
pprotein.adj.B1.4 <- (abs(pprotein.partial.B1.4) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(pprotein.adj.B1.4) <- 0
pprotein.adj.B2.4 <- (abs(pprotein.partial.B2.4) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(pprotein.adj.B2.4) <- 0

pprotein.g.B1.1 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(pprotein.adj.B1.1, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
pprotein.g.B2.1 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(pprotein.adj.B2.1, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
pprotein.g.B1.25 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(pprotein.adj.B1.25, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
pprotein.g.B2.25 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(pprotein.adj.B2.25, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
pprotein.g.B1.4 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(pprotein.adj.B1.4, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
pprotein.g.B2.4 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(pprotein.adj.B2.4, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

pprotein.stats.B1.1 <- network_mean_stats(pprotein.g.B1.1)
pprotein.stats.B2.1 <- network_mean_stats(pprotein.g.B2.1)
pprotein.stats.B1.25 <- network_mean_stats(pprotein.g.B1.25)
pprotein.stats.B2.25 <- network_mean_stats(pprotein.g.B2.25)
pprotein.stats.B1.4 <- network_mean_stats(pprotein.g.B1.4)
pprotein.stats.B2.4 <- network_mean_stats(pprotein.g.B2.4)

# Compare
pprotein.stats.comparison.1 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(pprotein.stats.B1.1),
  Batch1 = unlist(pprotein.stats.B1.1),
  Batch2 = unlist(pprotein.stats.B2.1)
)
pprotein.stats.comparison.25 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(pprotein.stats.B1.25),
  Batch1 = unlist(pprotein.stats.B1.25),
  Batch2 = unlist(pprotein.stats.B2.25)
)
pprotein.stats.comparison.4 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(pprotein.stats.B1.4),
  Batch1 = unlist(pprotein.stats.B1.4),
  Batch2 = unlist(pprotein.stats.B2.4)
)


# Compare (Protein Level)
pprotein.network.stats.1.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(pprotein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.1=degree(pprotein.g.B1.1),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.1=betweenness(pprotein.g.B1.1),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.1=closeness(pprotein.g.B1.1)
                                   )
pprotein.network.stats.1.B2 <- data.frame(Gene.B2=colnames(pprotein.df.B2),
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.1=degree(pprotein.g.B2.1),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.1=betweenness(pprotein.g.B2.1),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.1=closeness(pprotein.g.B2.1)
                                   )
pprotein.network.stats.25.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(pprotein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.25=degree(pprotein.g.B1.25),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.25=betweenness(pprotein.g.B1.25),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.25=closeness(pprotein.g.B1.25)
                                   )
pprotein.network.stats.25.B2 <- data.frame(Gene.B2=colnames(pprotein.df.B2),
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.25=degree(pprotein.g.B2.25),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.25=betweenness(pprotein.g.B2.25),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.25=closeness(pprotein.g.B2.25)
                                   )
pprotein.network.stats.4.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(pprotein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.4=degree(pprotein.g.B1.4),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.4=betweenness(pprotein.g.B1.4),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.4=closeness(pprotein.g.B1.4)
                                   )
pprotein.network.stats.4.B2 <- data.frame(Gene.B2=colnames(pprotein.df.B2),
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.4=degree(pprotein.g.B2.4),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.4=betweenness(pprotein.g.B2.4),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.4=closeness(pprotein.g.B2.4)
                                   )


pprotein.network.stats.1 <- inner_join(pprotein.network.stats.1.B1,pprotein.network.stats.1.B2,by=c("Gene.B1" = "Gene.B2")) |>
  select(Gene=Gene.B1,degree.central.B1.rho.0.1,degree.central.B2.rho.0.1,betweenness.B1.rho.0.1,betweenness.B2.rho.0.1,
         closeness.B1.rho.0.1,closeness.B2.rho.0.1)
pprotein.network.stats.25 <- inner_join(pprotein.network.stats.25.B1,pprotein.network.stats.25.B2,by=c("Gene.B1" = "Gene.B2")) |>
  select(Gene=Gene.B1,degree.central.B1.rho.0.25,degree.central.B2.rho.0.25,betweenness.B1.rho.0.25,betweenness.B2.rho.0.25,
         closeness.B1.rho.0.25,closeness.B2.rho.0.25)
pprotein.network.stats.4 <- inner_join(pprotein.network.stats.4.B1,pprotein.network.stats.4.B2,by=c("Gene.B1" = "Gene.B2")) |>
  select(Gene=Gene.B1,degree.central.B1.rho.0.4,degree.central.B2.rho.0.4,betweenness.B1.rho.0.4,betweenness.B2.rho.0.4,
         closeness.B1.rho.0.4,closeness.B2.rho.0.4)

pprotein.network.stats.1[is.na(pprotein.network.stats.1)] <- 0
pprotein.network.stats.25[is.na(pprotein.network.stats.25)] <- 0
pprotein.network.stats.4[is.na(pprotein.network.stats.4)] <- 0
```

## Networks all metabolites together (ICMS, HILIC)


```{r hilicicmsnetwork, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11.5, fig.height=7, dpi=300}

# combining datasets

hilic.icms.df.B1 <- cbind(hilic.df.B1.sorted,icms.df.B1.sorted)
hilic.icms.df.B2 <- cbind(hilic.df.B2.sorted,icms.df.B2.sorted)

hilic.icms.df.B1.s <- var(hilic.icms.df.B1)
hilic.icms.df.B2.s <- var(hilic.icms.df.B2)


hilic.icms.new.ann.B1 <- rbind(hilic.new.ann.B1.sorted,icms.new.ann.B1.sorted)
hilic.icms.new.ann.B1$Type <- rep(c("HILIC","ICMS"),times=c(dim(hilic.df.B1.sorted)[2],dim(icms.df.B1.sorted)[2]))
hilic.icms.new.ann.B2 <- rbind(hilic.new.ann.B2.sorted,icms.new.ann.B2.sorted)
hilic.icms.new.ann.B2$Type <- rep(c("HILIC","ICMS"),times=c(dim(hilic.df.B2.sorted)[2],dim(icms.df.B2.sorted)[2]))

hilic.icms.df.B1.a.5<-glasso(hilic.icms.df.B1.s, rho=rho1)
hilic.icms.df.B2.a.5<-glasso(hilic.icms.df.B2.s, rho=rho1)
hilic.icms.df.B1.a.75<-glasso(hilic.icms.df.B1.s, rho=rho2)
hilic.icms.df.B2.a.75<-glasso(hilic.icms.df.B2.s, rho=rho2)
hilic.icms.df.B1.a.9<-glasso(hilic.icms.df.B1.s, rho=rho3)
hilic.icms.df.B2.a.9<-glasso(hilic.icms.df.B2.s, rho=rho3)

# Convert precision matrix to partial correlations
hilic.icms.partial.B1.5 <- partial.cor(hilic.icms.df.B1.a.5$wi)
hilic.icms.partial.B2.5 <- partial.cor(hilic.icms.df.B2.a.5$wi)
hilic.icms.partial.B1.75 <- partial.cor(hilic.icms.df.B1.a.75$wi)
hilic.icms.partial.B2.75 <- partial.cor(hilic.icms.df.B2.a.75$wi)
hilic.icms.partial.B1.9 <- partial.cor(hilic.icms.df.B1.a.9$wi)
hilic.icms.partial.B2.9 <- partial.cor(hilic.icms.df.B2.a.9$wi)

# Threshold partial correlations
thresh <- 1e-5  # Set your desired threshold
hilic.icms.partial.B1.5[abs(hilic.icms.partial.B1.5) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.icms.partial.B2.5[abs(hilic.icms.partial.B2.5) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.icms.partial.B1.75[abs(hilic.icms.partial.B1.75) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.icms.partial.B2.75[abs(hilic.icms.partial.B2.75) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.icms.partial.B1.9[abs(hilic.icms.partial.B1.9) < thresh] <- 0
hilic.icms.partial.B2.9[abs(hilic.icms.partial.B2.9) < thresh] <- 0

diag(hilic.icms.partial.B1.5) <- 0
diag(hilic.icms.partial.B2.5) <- 0
diag(hilic.icms.partial.B1.75) <- 0
diag(hilic.icms.partial.B2.75) <- 0
diag(hilic.icms.partial.B1.9) <- 0
diag(hilic.icms.partial.B2.9) <- 0


# Identify and remove nodes with no remaining edges
hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.connected <- apply(hilic.icms.partial.B1.5, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.filtered <- hilic.icms.partial.B1.5[hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.connected, hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.labels.filtered <- hilic.icms.new.ann.B1$New.Name[hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.connected <- apply(hilic.icms.partial.B2.5, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.filtered <- hilic.icms.partial.B2.5[hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.connected, hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.labels.filtered <- hilic.icms.new.ann.B2$New.Name[hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.connected]

hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.connected <- apply(hilic.icms.partial.B1.75, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.filtered <- hilic.icms.partial.B1.75[hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.connected, hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.labels.filtered <- hilic.icms.new.ann.B1$New.Name[hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B2.75.connected <- apply(hilic.icms.partial.B2.75, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.icms.partial.B2.75.filtered <- hilic.icms.partial.B2.75[hilic.icms.partial.B2.75.connected, hilic.icms.partial.B2.75.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B2.75.labels.filtered <- hilic.icms.new.ann.B2$New.Name[hilic.icms.partial.B2.75.connected]

hilic.icms.partial.B1.9.connected <- apply(hilic.icms.partial.B1.9, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.icms.partial.B1.9.filtered <- hilic.icms.partial.B1.9[hilic.icms.partial.B1.9.connected, hilic.icms.partial.B1.9.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B1.9.labels.filtered <- hilic.icms.new.ann.B1$New.Name[hilic.icms.partial.B1.9.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B2.9.connected <- apply(hilic.icms.partial.B2.9, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
hilic.icms.partial.B2.9.filtered <- hilic.icms.partial.B2.9[hilic.icms.partial.B2.9.connected, hilic.icms.partial.B2.9.connected]
hilic.icms.partial.B2.9.labels.filtered <- hilic.icms.new.ann.B2$New.Name[hilic.icms.partial.B2.9.connected]


# rho=0.5
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.7))

qgraph(hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.filtered, labels = hilic.icms.partial.B1.5.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.25, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC & ICMS (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho1),
       nodeNames = hilic.icms.new.ann.B1$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
qgraph(hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.filtered, labels = hilic.icms.partial.B2.5.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.25, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC & ICMS (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho1),
       nodeNames = hilic.icms.new.ann.B2$HMDB, legend = FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(hilic.icms.new.ann.B2$New.Name,": ",hilic.icms.new.ann.B2$HMDB), cex = 0.85, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

# rho=0.75
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1, 0.7))

qgraph(hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.filtered, labels = hilic.icms.partial.B1.75.labels.filtered, arrows = FALSE, diag = FALSE,
       label.cex = 1.25, vsize = 7, layout = "spring",
       title = paste0("HILIC & ICMS (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=", rho2),

hilic.icms.adj.B2.5 <- (abs(hilic.icms.partial.B2.5) > 1e-5) * 1
```

```{r protein_pproteinnetwork, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

# combining datasets

protein.pprotein.df.B1 <- cbind(protein.df.B1,pprotein.df.B1)
protein.pprotein.df.B2 <- cbind(protein.df.B2,pprotein.df.B2)

protein.pprotein.df.B1.s <- var(protein.pprotein.df.B1)
protein.pprotein.df.B2.s <- var(protein.pprotein.df.B2)

protein.pprotein.new.ann.B1 <- data.frame(Metabolite=colnames(protein.pprotein.df.B1),
                                          New.Name=paste0(rep("PPP",dim(protein.pprotein.df.B1)[2]),1:dim(protein.pprotein.df.B1)[2]),
                                          Type=rep(c("Protein","Phosphoprotein"),times=c(dim(protein.df.B1)[2],dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2])))
protein.pprotein.new.ann.B2 <- data.frame(Metabolite=colnames(protein.pprotein.df.B2),
                                          New.Name=paste0(rep("PPP",dim(protein.pprotein.df.B2)[2]),1:dim(protein.pprotein.df.B2)[2]),
                                          Type=rep(c("Protein","Phosphoprotein"),times=c(dim(protein.df.B1)[2],dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2])))

protein.pprotein.df.B1.a.1<-glasso(protein.pprotein.df.B1.s, rho=rho1p)
protein.pprotein.df.B2.a.1<-glasso(protein.pprotein.df.B2.s, rho=rho1p)
protein.pprotein.df.B1.a.25<-glasso(protein.pprotein.df.B1.s, rho=rho2p)
protein.pprotein.df.B2.a.25<-glasso(protein.pprotein.df.B2.s, rho=rho2p)
protein.pprotein.df.B1.a.4<-glasso(protein.pprotein.df.B1.s, rho=rho3p)
protein.pprotein.df.B2.a.4<-glasso(protein.pprotein.df.B2.s, rho=rho3p)

# Convert precision matrix to partial correlations
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1 <- partial.cor(protein.pprotein.df.B1.a.1$wi)
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1 <- partial.cor(protein.pprotein.df.B2.a.1$wi)
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25 <- partial.cor(protein.pprotein.df.B1.a.25$wi)
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25 <- partial.cor(protein.pprotein.df.B2.a.25$wi)
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4 <- partial.cor(protein.pprotein.df.B1.a.4$wi)
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4 <- partial.cor(protein.pprotein.df.B2.a.4$wi)

# Threshold partial correlations
thresh <- 1e-5  # Set your desired threshold
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1[abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1) < thresh] <- 0
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1[abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1) < thresh] <- 0
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25[abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25) < thresh] <- 0
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25[abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25) < thresh] <- 0
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4[abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4) < thresh] <- 0
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4[abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4) < thresh] <- 0

diag(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1) <- 0
diag(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1) <- 0
diag(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25) <- 0
diag(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25) <- 0
diag(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4) <- 0
diag(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4) <- 0


# Identify and remove nodes with no remaining edges
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected <- apply(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.filtered <- protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1[protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected, protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.labels.filtered <- protein.pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected <- apply(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.filtered <- protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1[protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected, protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.labels.filtered <- protein.pprotein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.connected]

protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected <- apply(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.filtered <- protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25[protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected, protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.labels.filtered <- protein.pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected <- apply(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.filtered <- protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25[protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected, protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.labels.filtered <- protein.pprotein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.connected]

protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected <- apply(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4.filtered <- protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4[protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected, protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4.labels.filtered <- protein.pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name[protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected <- apply(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4, 1, function(x) any(x != 0))
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4.filtered <- protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4[protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected, protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected]
protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4.labels.filtered <- protein.pprotein.new.ann.B2$New.Name[protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4.connected]

# rho=0.1
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.8))

qgraph(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.filtered, labels = protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE,
       diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.1, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProtein/Protein (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho1p),
       nodeNames = protein.pprotein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.filtered, labels = protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE,
       diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.1, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProtein/Protein (Batch 2), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho1p),
       nodeNames = protein.pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
plot.new()
legend("left", legend = paste0(protein.pprotein.new.ann.B1$New.Name,": ", protein.pprotein.new.ann.B2$Metabolite), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

# rho=0.25
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 1), widths = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.8))

qgraph(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.filtered, labels = protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE,
       diag=FALSE, label.cex=1.1, vsize=10,
       layout="spring", title = paste0("PProtein/Protein (Batch 1), FDR<0.1, glasso rho=",rho2p),
       nodeNames = protein.pprotein.new.ann.B1$Metabolite, legend=FALSE)
qgraph(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.filtered, labels = protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25.labels.filtered, arrows=FALSE,

# rho=0.4

# Convert to adjacency matrices (non-zero off-diagonal entries indicate edges)
protein.pprotein.adj.B1.1 <- (abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.1) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.pprotein.adj.B1.1) <- 0
protein.pprotein.adj.B2.1 <- (abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.1) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.pprotein.adj.B2.1) <- 0
protein.pprotein.adj.B1.25 <- (abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.25) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.pprotein.adj.B1.25) <- 0
protein.pprotein.adj.B2.25 <- (abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.25) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.pprotein.adj.B2.25) <- 0
protein.pprotein.adj.B1.4 <- (abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B1.4) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.pprotein.adj.B1.4) <- 0
protein.pprotein.adj.B2.4 <- (abs(protein.pprotein.partial.B2.4) > 1e-5) * 1
diag(protein.pprotein.adj.B2.4) <- 0

protein.pprotein.g.B1.1 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.pprotein.adj.B1.1, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.pprotein.g.B2.1 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.pprotein.adj.B2.1, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.pprotein.g.B1.25 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.pprotein.adj.B1.25, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
protein.pprotein.g.B2.25 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.pprotein.adj.B2.25, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

protein.pprotein.g.B2.4 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(protein.pprotein.adj.B2.4, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

protein.pprotein.stats.B1.1 <- network_mean_stats(protein.pprotein.g.B1.1)
protein.pprotein.stats.B2.1 <- network_mean_stats(protein.pprotein.g.B2.1)
protein.pprotein.stats.B1.25 <- network_mean_stats(protein.pprotein.g.B1.25)
protein.pprotein.stats.B2.25 <- network_mean_stats(protein.pprotein.g.B2.25)
protein.pprotein.stats.B1.4 <- network_mean_stats(protein.pprotein.g.B1.4)
protein.pprotein.stats.B2.4 <- network_mean_stats(protein.pprotein.g.B2.4)

# Compare
protein.pprotein.stats.comparison.1 <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(protein.pprotein.stats.B1.1),
  Batch1 = unlist(protein.pprotein.stats.B1.1),

)

)

)


# Compare (Metabolite Level)
protein.pprotein.network.stats.1.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(protein.pprotein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.1=degree(protein.pprotein.g.B1.1),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.1=betweenness(protein.pprotein.g.B1.1),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.1=closeness(protein.pprotein.g.B1.1),
                                   Type=rep(c("Protein","PProtein"),times=c(dim(protein.df.B1)[2],dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2]))
                                   )

                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.1=degree(protein.pprotein.g.B2.1),
                                   betweenness.B2.rho.0.1=betweenness(protein.pprotein.g.B2.1),
                                   closeness.B2.rho.0.1=closeness(protein.pprotein.g.B2.1),
                                   Type=rep(c("Protein","PProtein"),times=c(dim(protein.df.B1)[2],dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2]))
                                   )
protein.pprotein.network.stats.25.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(protein.pprotein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.25=degree(protein.pprotein.g.B1.25),
                                   betweenness.B1.rho.0.25=betweenness(protein.pprotein.g.B1.25),
                                   closeness.B1.rho.0.25=closeness(protein.pprotein.g.B1.25),
                                   Type=rep(c("Protein","PProtein"),times=c(dim(protein.df.B1)[2],dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2]))
                                   )

                                   Type=rep(c("Protein","PProtein"),times=c(dim(protein.df.B1)[2],dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2]))
                                   )
protein.pprotein.network.stats.4.B1 <- data.frame(Gene.B1=colnames(protein.pprotein.df.B1),
                                   degree.central.B1.rho.0.4=degree(protein.pprotein.g.B1.4),

                                   Type=rep(c("Protein","PProtein"),times=c(dim(protein.df.B1)[2],dim(pprotein.df.B1)[2]))
                                   )
protein.pprotein.network.stats.4.B2 <- data.frame(Gene.B2=colnames(protein.pprotein.df.B2),
                                   degree.central.B2.rho.0.4=degree(protein.pprotein.g.B2.4),

protein.pprotein.network.stats.1 <- inner_join(protein.pprotein.network.stats.1.B1,protein.pprotein.network.stats.1.B2,
                                                 by=c("Gene.B1" = "Gene.B2")) |>
```

```{r protein_pprotein_plots, echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
  geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y = "Density") +
  ggtitle("Protein & PProtein: Batch Comparison - Density") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplot(protein.pprotein.stats.comparison.clust.coeff,aes(x=rho,y=clustering_coeff,color=Batch)) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y = "Clustering Coefficient") +
  ggtitle("Protein & PProtein: Batch Comparison - Clustering Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplot(protein.pprotein.stats.comparison.degree.cent,aes(x=rho,y=degree_centrality,color=Batch)) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y = "Degree Centrality") +
  ggtitle("Protein & PProtein: Batch Comparison - Degree Centrality") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplot(protein.pprotein.stats.comparison.between.cent,aes(x=rho,y=betweenness_centrality,color=Batch)) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y = "Betweenness Centrality") +
  ggtitle("Protein & PProtein: Batch Comparison - Betweenness Centrality") +
  theme_minimal()
```
